note: Stage 42 (Issue #88 north): real towns of 樺太(北緯50度以南). Names are real (樺太庁の町). 'pos' is world km in the same frame as the 樺太 island outline (calibrated on 豊原 = [516.94, 1101.28]); 'snap' = the town is moved to the nearest coast cell within 3 cells (a harbour town on a 5 km grid). 'pop' is a reference figure from a SEARCH-RESULT SNIPPET of a 1940s source (not verified against the primary table) and is scaled like every other town (POP_1950_SCALE): it is a size hint for the game, not a statistic. 本斗 is not here: no figure was found. 千島 is not here: its world position is not resolved yet (docs/NORTH41.md).
